frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Socle front authentification et comptes
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Rendre possible la connexion, la session utilisateur, les gardes de routes, la recuperation de mot de passe et les premiers parcours de creation de compte.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Profile, finance and legal data are mocked only enough to complete registration screens.
Dashboard target route can show a placeholder until dashboard-notification-service exists.

frontTests.item: Login success stores token and redirects by role.
Login failure displays an error without losing form state.
Protected route redirects anonymous user to login.
Student registration validates required administrative and RGPD fields.
Teacher registration entry redirects to the teacher-specific flow.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Expose public auth and account creation routes.

definitionOfDone.item: A user can log in and the front knows role and account status.
All following phases can reuse the same API client and auth state.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
